text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It has arrived once again this year,
this very season...!
choice_data_list: You're as fired up as ever this year!
You're full of fighting spirit again this year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, after all, the Autumn Tenno Sho is just ahead of us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Having conquered the spring, my desire for the Spring-Autumn double crown has grown even stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I will train myself even further at summer camp and achieve a historic first for the Mejiro family!
choice_data_list: I'll help with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, no matter how rigorous
the training is, I am ready!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please give me the training I need
to win at the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
—My final summer training camp with Mejiro McQueen has begun!
